title: okf-mcp
description: Every metric okf-mcp exports on /metrics; histograms as heatmaps.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: The running build (okf_build_info's version label).

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: HTTP requests per second, all routes.

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of HTTP responses with a 5xx status (0 with traffic and no 5xx; no data with no traffic).

panels.title: MCP sessions
panels.description: Open MCP sessions.

panels.title: DB connections in use
panels.description: Postgres pool connections in use.

panels.title: Clock offset
panels.description: Time server's clock minus ours, at the last check.

panels.title: Request rate by route
panels.description: Requests per second, by matched route.

panels.title: Responses by status
panels.description: Responses per second, by status code.

panels.title: Request duration
panels.description: Every HTTP request's duration, in the server's own buckets.

panels.title: Request latency quantiles
panels.description: p50, p95 and p99 across all routes.

panels.title: Request p95 by route
panels.description: p95 duration per route.

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: HTTP requests being served, by method and route.

panels.title: Tool calls by tool
panels.description: Tool calls per second, by tool and outcome.

panels.title: Tool error ratio by tool
panels.description: Share of each tool's calls that failed (0 for a tool that has never failed).

targets.expr: (sum by (tool) (rate(okf_mcp_tool_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",outcome="error"}[$__rate_interval])) or on(tool) (0 * sum by (tool) (rate(okf_mcp_tool_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])))) / sum by (tool) (rate(okf_mcp_tool_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Tool call duration ($tool)
panels.description: Tool call durations for the tools picked in the Tool variable.

panels.title: Tool call p95 by tool
panels.description: p95 duration per tool.

panels.title: Open MCP sessions
panels.description: Open MCP sessions over time.

panels.title: Publishes by outcome
panels.description: Publishes per second.

panels.title: Lint rejections by rule
panels.description: Publish lint errors, by rule, per interval.

panels.title: Publish duration
panels.description: Time to publish a changeset.

panels.title: Publish lock wait
panels.description: Time a publish waited for its catalog's lock.

panels.title: Publish duration quantiles
panels.description: p50, p95 and p99 publish duration.

panels.title: Publish lock wait quantiles
panels.description: p50, p95 and p99 lock wait.

panels.title: Catalog announcements by result
panels.description: Catalog generation announcements received from other replicas (with [redis]), by result.

panels.title: Key cache reloads
panels.description: Key cache and settings reloads, by outcome.

panels.title: Open changesets
panels.description: Open changesets in the cluster, as of the last cluster_stats housekeeping job (every replica reports the same value).

panels.title: Sign-in attempts
panels.description: Sign-in attempts per interval, by method and outcome.

panels.title: OAuth tokens issued
panels.description: Tokens issued per interval, by grant.

panels.title: Rate-limit rejections
panels.description: Requests a limiter turned away, by limiter, and decisions a replica made from its own bucket because the shared one failed (any bar means the limit is per replica).

panels.title: OAuth refreshes by result
panels.description: Refresh-token presentations per interval. grace is normal for clients with several processes; a reused result ended a connection.

panels.title: Mail jobs
panels.description: Mail jobs finished per interval, by provider and outcome.

panels.title: Mail queue depth
panels.description: Mail jobs not yet sent, by status, as of the last poll (max across replicas, which count the same queue).

panels.title: Archive duration
panels.description: Archive export and import durations.

panels.title: Archive duration quantiles
panels.description: p50, p95 and p99 archive duration, by direction.

panels.title: Archive throughput
panels.description: Archive bytes moved per second, by direction.

panels.title: Archives by direction and outcome
panels.description: Finished archive operations per interval.

panels.title: DB pool connections
panels.description: Postgres pool connections, by state (sums to pool size).

panels.title: Clock offset
panels.description: Time server's clock minus ours, at the last check.

panels.title: Clock checks
panels.description: Clock checks per interval, by outcome.

panels.title: Redis errors
panels.description: Failed Redis calls per interval, by operation (only with [redis]).

panels.title: Telemetry export failures
panels.description: OTLP exports that failed, by signal and reason.

panels.title: Cache lookups by cache and result
panels.description: Bounded cache lookups per second, by cache and result (hit, miss, or a stale entry that was revalidated or reloaded).

panels.title: Cache evictions by cache and cause
panels.description: Entries removed from each bounded cache per interval, by cause: size (cache full), ttl (expired) or invalidated.

panels.title: Cache entries
panels.description: Entries currently held by each bounded cache.

panels.title: Cache bytes
panels.description: Estimated bytes held by each cache that is limited by bytes (caches limited by entry count report nothing).

panels.title: Cache load duration
panels.description: Bounded cache load durations (the loader for a miss or a stale entry), across all caches.

panels.title: Cache load duration quantiles
panels.description: p50, p95 and p99 bounded cache load duration, by cache.

panels.title: Change feed lag
panels.description: Time from a change-feed message being sent to this replica applying it.

panels.title: Change feed lag quantiles
panels.description: p50, p95 and p99 of the change-feed lag.

panels.title: Change feed messages queued and received by kind
panels.description: Messages queued by writes and messages received per interval, by kind. A rolled-back write is queued but never received.

panels.title: Unreadable change-feed payloads
panels.description: Payloads this build could not read; each makes the replica reload its caches.

panels.title: Housekeeping job duration
panels.description: How long each housekeeping job took, every task together.

panels.title: Housekeeping p95 by task
panels.description: p95 housekeeping job duration, by task.

panels.title: Housekeeping runs by task and outcome
panels.description: Housekeeping jobs run per interval across replicas, by task and outcome (an error is retried).
